findings.failureMode: The Baseline Signoff Module accepts any 64-hex signatureDigest plus caller-asserted VALIDATED state; its tests intentionally use synthetic hashes and can derive BASELINE_CLOSED.
findings.requiredClosure: Introduce a trusted evidence verification seam with controlled-approval readback and detached-signature Adapters; remove any signature method that has no real verifier. Closure must bind signer authority, approval event bytes, role, decision, payload and revocation state.

findings.failureMode: approvalSystemRef, workflowInstanceRef, workflow owner, evidence custodian, dueAt, escalation and revocation source exist only in prose and are not part of a machine-validated Interface.
findings.requiredClosure: Add a Baseline Signoff Execution Control Module and bind its digest into every signoff payload and Acceptance Envelope. Expired, cancelled, unreadable or revoked workflow control must fail closed.

findings.failureMode: ACTIVE revocation state and CLOSED conditions are caller assertions; sealing has no fresh as-of revocation or condition-evidence readback and cannot detect later revocation.
findings.requiredClosure: Derive condition, validation and revocation states through trusted Adapters using fresh bounded readback evidence; verify again at the formal-release decision time.

findings.failureMode: The Formal Launch Readiness Module validates evidencePath and sha256 shapes but does not resolve files, recompute digests or invoke evidence-kind validators. A nonexistent path and fabricated digest can be structurally accepted as CLOSED evidence.
findings.requiredClosure: Add a restricted Evidence Resolver seam with realpath and symlink protection, byte-digest verification, evidence-kind dispatch and release/environment binding. Structural validity must never equal Gate closure.

findings.failureMode: No deep Module consumes GitHub workflow, job, check-run, artifact and ruleset readback. Check names are not bound to App identity and PR head, tested merge, base and post-merge SHA roles are conflated.
findings.requiredClosure: Add a Remote CI Evidence Registry that distinguishes SHA roles and binds repository, workflow blob/path, run attempt, event, job/check identity, GitHub App, artifact bytes and active protection readback. It remains non-networking and non-authorizing until supplied by a trusted readback Adapter.

findings.failureMode: The Content/UED Authorization Module correctly labels its result STRUCTURE_ONLY_UNTRUSTED_INPUT, but a complete synthetic bundle built from sha256(seed), fabricated references and fabricated signature digests still passes structure verification.
findings.requiredClosure: Formal release logic must reject structureValid, allEvidenceStructureValid, allEnvironmentStructuresValid or verify=true as proof of external acceptance. Add a second trusted Evidence Resolution layer before any Gate can close.

findings.failureMode: Source provenance is commit-tree based but does not explicitly bind sourceTreeObjectId, worktree exclusion, the complete release/build tooling set or deployed artifact bytes.
findings.requiredClosure: Create provenance v2 with COMMIT_TREE_ONLY semantics, complete toolchain/build-input coverage and separate Backend OCI, Admin bundle, Cloud Function archive and mini-program upload-package digests.

findings.failureMode: Time, revocation snapshot, opaque references, activity publication facts, UED coverage counts and photography rights applicability are supplied by the caller; the photography asset-set digest covers only assetRef and cleanMasterDigest.
findings.requiredClosure: Use trusted clock and evidence-resolution Adapters, derive counts and state from readback, and bind all rights metadata plus current revocation state into the published asset-set digest.

sequencingDecision.startCondition: R11 is either executed under exact authorization or explicitly cancelled and superseded by a newly frozen packet.
sequencingDecision.reason: Changing backend, contracts, scripts or workflow now would invalidate the exact R11 execution-input manifest while authorization is pending.
